port.description: HTTP server listen port. Overridden by the ROUTERLLM_PORT environment variable.

cooldown.description: How long a key is skipped after a dead response (401/402/403). Go duration syntax; compound values like 1h30m are allowed.

force_stream.description: Always serve /v1/chat/completions responses as Anthropic-style SSE, regardless of the client's stream flag.

dedupe_tools.description: Drop duplicate outbound tool definitions (same function name, first wins) on every leg. A leg's own dedupe_tools still works when this is off.

allow_client_headers.description: If specified, only these client headers are forwarded (case-insensitive; hop-by-hop headers are always blocked).

system_prompt_file.description: Path to a file whose contents are prepended as a system message.

apiKey.description: API key(s). A string may be a ${VAR} environment reference; env values containing commas are split into multiple keys.

headers.description: Additional HTTP headers sent to the provider.

style.description: Provider API style: openai (passthrough), anthropic (translated to /v1/messages), cline (Cline account auth), google (translated to Gemini generateContent), alysis (Alysis gateway account auth).

base_url.description: Provider base URL. A trailing / and /v1 suffix are trimmed automatically.

reasoning_style.description: Reasoning dialect for openai-style providers: openai (reasoning_effort only), openrouter (reasoning map), qwen (enable_thinking/thinking_budget), raw (legacy passthrough).

share.description: Shared key group: providers with the same share value share keys and cooldown state.

query.description: Query string appended verbatim to every upstream request path, including the leading '?' (e.g. "?beta=true").

disabled.description: When true, this provider is skipped entirely and its api_key/credential validation is relaxed — use it to park a provider without deleting it.

reasoning_effort.description: Canonical reasoning effort: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, or max (ultra normalizes to max). Re-emitted in the target provider's reasoning dialect. Only applied when the request doesn't already set a reasoning preference.

enable_thinking.description: false maps the route to effort "none" (thinking off); true defers to any explicit reasoning_effort.

provider.description: Provider name. Must match a provider defined above.

model.description: Upstream model name. Required — there is no fallback to model_id.

disabled.description: When true, this upstream route entry is skipped; other entries for the same model_id still serve it.

stylecall.description: Upstream API dialect for this leg: chat (/v1/chat/completions), responses (/v1/responses), or messages (/v1/messages). Empty or absent lets the provider style decide.

sanitize_tool_names.description: Normalize outbound tool/function names on this leg so strict upstreams accept them.

dedupe_tools.description: Drop duplicate outbound tool definitions on this leg, keeping the first occurrence.

disabled.description: Park the whole chain: the model disappears from /v1/models and requests 404, while its yaml block (and every leg) stays intact.
